editorial:
Ever wondered what would happen if you made a social media app designed to connect you with people you actually hate? That is exactly what happens here. You follow a smart young hacker who decides to flip the script on friendship apps by creating a platform that matches enemies. It starts off as a wild social experiment, but things get dark very quickly. The vibe is tense and moody, making you feel the pressure as the creator realizes her app has unlocked something dangerous. You will feel for the main character as she tries to handle the chaos she accidentally started.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is actually behind the killings. The acting is solid, and the pacing stays quick so you never feel bored. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the overall tension makes it a fun ride. If you enjoy tech-themed mysteries, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the app was being manipulated by a hidden user who took the antisocial concept too far. It turns out the killings weren't random, but a targeted plan to punish those the hacker hated. In the final scenes, the creator has to use her own coding skills to track down the killer. After a tense showdown, she manages to stop the murderer and shuts the app down for good to prevent more death.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tech thrillers and stories about social media gone wrong.
